summary: RREEF Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly distribution declaration for June 2026. The filing provides a table of gross, adjusted, and net distribution per share for eight share classes (Class A, I, D, M-I, N, T, T2, Z), with gross distributions of $0.07495 per share and net amounts after fees ranging from $0.05831 to $0.07495. The distribution is payable on July 2, 2026, to holders of record as of July 1, 2026. This is a routine compliance filing concerning ordinary dividend payments and does not involve a corporate transaction, restructuring, or special situation. No risk-arb or unusual event is present.
